document_integrity.manifest_topic_coverage: Every manifest topic must have exactly one search document per locale.
document_integrity.extra_document_topics: No search document may reference a topic outside manifest.topics.
document_integrity.duplicate_document_ids: Duplicate locale:topic document IDs are rejected.
document_integrity.wrong_locale: Document locale, URL prefix, and source output path must match the active locale.

anchor_integrity.target_anchor_validation: Every target-map anchor_id used by policy/CIS/API/topic/capability targets must exist in the target topic anchors.
anchor_integrity.target_topic_validation: Every target-map topic_id must exist in manifest topics.

inventory_gap_integrity.firefox_policy: Every Firefox policy ID from the generated policy index must have a policy target.
inventory_gap_integrity.cis: Every CIS recommendation/provenance record from the generated CIS index must have a CIS target.
inventory_gap_integrity.api: Every API operation from the API documentation inventory must have an API target.
